fields.description: The word as a learner meets it in a lesson — e.g. Annular space, Breakpoint chlorination, GFCI.
fields.label: Term

fields.description: Other spellings this term is matched on, one per line — plurals, the expanded form of an acronym, a hyphenated variant. Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive, so "GFCIs" needs a line of its own but "gfci" does not.
fields.label: Also written as

fields.description: Unticking hides the term from Help everywhere without deleting what somebody wrote.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: One or two plain sentences, no jargon. THIS IS THE ONLY FIELD SHOWN DURING A QUIZ — write it so it defines the word without answering a question about it.
fields.label: In plain English

fields.description: Tick when the word means something different in ordinary English than it does in this trade. These are the ones people get wrong without ever realising they are confused.
fields.label: Means something else in everyday English

fields.description: What somebody would reasonably assume it meant — so the lesson can say plainly that it is not that.
fields.label: What it sounds like it means

fields.description: The concept, for somebody who has the definition and still does not get it. Not shown during a quiz.
fields.label: Explained

fields.description: A made-up, concrete example — a specific situation a technician would recognise. Invent the scenario freely; do NOT invent a figure that would really come from a product label, a data sheet or an engineer. Not shown during a quiz.
fields.label: For example

fields.description: Related terms, one per line. Each is shown as a link if it exists in the glossary and ignored if it does not, so a forward reference is safe.
fields.label: See also

fields.description: Drafted by a machine. Nothing is gated on this — a glossary entry is not an answer key — but Help says so on an unreviewed entry rather than presenting it as settled.
fields.label: AI Drafted

fields.description: Set when somebody has read this entry and stands behind it.
fields.label: Reviewed By
